Ack — good notes. Quick operational points: 
- HubSpot send throttling: we can push ~5k in one batch without issues; anything above that we should stagger over 2 windows (same day). Your seed is ~3.2k so single batch is fine.
- 2-hour reminder: HubSpot sequence can do a day-of 2-hour window but only if we use the same timezone send (we can schedule a smart send for Pacific at 10:00 PT and a 2-hour follow-up via time-based workflow). I will build the workflows and test in the staging campaign.
- Suppression logic: the 180-day blanket is implementable — I'll run a dry-run suppression check against the CSV and push a results file.

HubSpot campaign id: WEB-2026-06-09 (internal id 984512). Will drop the staging copy to the drive and share link once the workflows are live.

—Tessa
